intro.title: The fire is out. Where were the firebreaks?
intro.lede: You know the minute the fire reached a few squares. Work out where the firebreaks stood. There is one answer, and you never have to guess.

rules.title: Four rules. That is the whole game.
rules.one: The fire starts at the star and spreads one square a minute. Up, down, left, right. Never diagonally.
rules.two: It cannot cross a firebreak. It has to go around, and that costs minutes.
rules.three: Every number is the exact minute the fire arrived. Not earlier, not later.
rules.four: Place exactly the number of firebreaks you are given. Every other square must burn.

foot.promise: Every fire has exactly one answer and can be solved without guessing.
